_comment: AQUASPECT scene manifest — exact scene IDs and parameters for deterministic data retrieval.
_status: CONFIRMED for Tanager (El Gouna). Sentinel-2 scenes TBD after STAC search.
_strategy: Dual-AOI: Tanager for El Gouna Red Sea hyperspectral analysis; Sentinel-2 for Lake Manzala water-quality time-series.

aoi_tanager.name: El Gouna — Red Sea Coastal Water
aoi_tanager.description: Red Sea coastal water north of El Gouna. Covered by the only confirmed open-archive Planet Tanager scene over Egypt. Suitable for coral reef / marine water quality screening.
aoi_tanager.why_selected: Only open-archive Tanager scene over Egypt in the coastal-water-bodies collection. CC-BY-4.0 licensed. 8% cloud cover. Acquired 2025-09-26.

aoi_sentinel2.name: Lake Manzala
aoi_sentinel2.description: Egypt's largest coastal lagoon (~572 km²). Hypereutrophic. Receives wastewater from multiple Nile Delta drains (Bahr Al-Baqar, Hadous, El-Serw). Documented HABs and high turbidity. CGLS LWQ product available as external benchmark.
aoi_sentinel2.why_selected: Best Egyptian water body for validation: published NIOF in-situ WQI data, CGLS LWQ benchmark, documented HABs, strong optical signal contrast.

sentinel2.notes: SCL cloud classes to exclude: 3 (shadow), 8 (medium cloud), 9 (high cloud), 10 (thin cirrus)
